title: 🔄 UPDATE: Small Savings Scheme Interest Rates Unchanged for July–September 2026 Quarter (Q2 FY27)
summary: Finance Ministry retains small savings interest rates for Q2 FY27: SSY and SCSS at 8.20%, PPF at 7.10%, NSC at 7.70%.

blocks.title: 🔄 CHRONOLOGICAL UPDATE — SMALL SAVINGS TIME-SERIES
blocks.text: Subsequent quarterly rate notification linked to baseline note [Small Savings Q4 FY26 Rates](migrated-ca-2026-01-sec4-1).

items: **Q2 FY27 Rates Unchanged**: Ministry of Finance notified unchanged interest rates across all small savings instruments for July–September 2026.

**Key Instrument Rates**: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) at **8.20%**, Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) at **8.20%**, National Savings Certificate (NSC) at **7.70%**, Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) at **7.50%** (matures in 115 months), and Public Provident Fund (PPF) at **7.10%**.
**Post Office Savings Account**: Rate retained at **4.00%**.
**Relationship to Baseline**: Maintains continuous rate freeze from Q4 FY26 baseline (`migrated-ca-2026-01-sec4-1`) into Q2 FY27.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on the top-yielding instruments (SSY & SCSS at 8.20%) and PPF rate (7.10% with tax-free EEE status under Section 80C).
